Update an existing lead opportunity.

Required: contact_id (always required for updates)

Update Behavior:
Three independent operations:

Assignment update (assigned_user_id)

Stage update (stage.id)

Lead opportunity update (other fields)

Product Values: Partial updates merge with existing values.

Marketing attribution: utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_medium are optional strings, each patched independently. Omit a field to leave its stored value unchanged; send a field to overwrite it.
